tasks.title: NotificationTemplate model + DDL
tasks.parallelism_notes: Leaf module (spec Module 1). Own model + .sql files. Only overlap with TASK-2154 is a one-line export in handlers/models/__init__.py — trivial to reconcile, but it IS a shared file, so a parallel worktree run needs that one merge.

tasks.title: NotificationBatchRecipient model + DDL (flat tracking table)
tasks.parallelism_notes: Leaf module (spec Module 2). Same one-line handlers/models/__init__.py overlap with TASK-2153; no other shared file. Encodes the pending/publishing/queued/skipped/publish_failed state machine as a CHECK constraint.

tasks.title: Placeholder catalog module
tasks.parallelism_notes: Fully independent (spec Module 3): one new module, one new test file, zero shared files. The single genuinely conflict-free task in the feature — the best candidate if any parallelism is attempted.

tasks.title: Recipient ingestion — JSON / multipart / base64 to normalized rows
tasks.parallelism_notes: Independent (spec Module 4): creates the services/comm_center package with its own models.py and ingest.py. TASK-2157/2159/2161 later extend models.py, so parallel runs must land this first.

tasks.title: Render + validation core — prepare(), partial render, wire payloads
tasks.parallelism_notes: Sequential: needs the catalog's function names (2155) and the RecipientIn shape (2156), and extends services/comm_center/models.py. This is the shared core every send path routes through — the highest-risk task, carrying all three verified wire traps.

tasks.title: Fan-out, status state machine, aggregation and retry
tasks.parallelism_notes: Sequential: consumes the tracking model (2154) and the prepared payloads (2157). Sole owner of Redis I/O and the duplicate-delivery containment state machine.

tasks.title: CommCenterHandler — auth, content-type dispatch, sender routes
tasks.parallelism_notes: Sequential and the feature's serialization point: creates comm_center.py, which TASK-2160/2161/2162 all edit. Registers every route and leaves explicit NotImplementedError stubs for the methods those tasks fill in.

tasks.title: Templates CRUD endpoints
tasks.parallelism_notes: Sequential: fills stubs inside comm_center.py (2159) against the template model (2153). Hand-written CRUD, not a ModelView, per the resolved spec decision.

tasks.title: Single-recipient endpoint — POST /api/v1/comm_center/message
tasks.parallelism_notes: Sequential: fills the post_message stub in comm_center.py (2159) and calls publish_one (2158). Deliberately a thin arity-1 caller over the shared prepare(); a payload-parity test enforces that it does not fork the pipeline.

tasks.title: Dry-run mode on both send endpoints
tasks.parallelism_notes: Sequential and last of the behavior tasks: touches render.py, dispatch.py and comm_center.py, and must cover BOTH send endpoints, so it needs 2161 in place. Guard is enforced at the service layer so no future caller can bypass it.

tasks.title: Packaging extra, route wiring, integration tests and acceptance sweep
tasks.parallelism_notes: Terminal task: declares the comm-center extra, wires routes into the app, adds the cross-cutting integration suite and runs the full spec section 5 acceptance sweep. Depends on every other task by construction.
